objectives.label: Rob the pack train {direction} of {settlement}, {distance} out

title: A quiet job on the road
A pack train, lightly guarded
summary: {giver} knows of a merchant's pack train resting {distance} to the {direction}, heavy with goods and lightly watched. A crime, if anyone sees.
offer: There is a merchant's train camped {distance} {direction} of here. Nobody watching but the llamas. Take what they carry and I'll pay for the trouble — and I never heard of you.
progress: Done it yet? Keep your voice down.
complete: Lovely. I'll move it on before anyone asks. Here's your cut.
